c1.evidence: Offer: Serve as an Election Day poll worker for the Kenton County Board of Elections in Kentucky.

c2.evidence: Requirements: Be a registered voter in Kenton County; report to the assigned polling place by 5:15 a.m.; take a training session prior to the election.

s1.note: Pay is a fixed per-election-day flat fee set by the county election commission: $150.00 for Election Day plus $30.00 for training.

s2.note: Election Day is a fourteen (14) hour day; workers get a short break but there is no designated hour for lunch.

s3.note: Training is required prior to the election and is compensated at a flat $30.00 for election-day workers.

s4.note: The office documents a progression of county-set rates (2006: $125 + $20 training; 2018: $150 + $20 training; 2021-2023 primary/early-voting compensation at $12.00/hr; Election Day flat $150.00 + $30.00 training).

s5.note: Early voting and primary work are compensated separately (flat fees or $12.00/hr depending on role); Election Day roles listed include flat $150.00, ED-Troubleshooter $210.00, and ED-Technician $150.00.

s6.note: Kenton County polls are open 6 a.m. to 6 p.m.; poll workers must report to their assigned polling place by 5:15 a.m.

s7.note: The schedule does not promise overtime beyond the flat Election Day fee; shift is described as a flat fourteen-hour day.
